rca of the issue: PUT /api/roles/{role_id} 500: rbac.py:90 passes after=list(updates.keys()); audit.py:42 _diff does set(before.keys()) | set(after.keys()), which fails on list. Reproduce: as admin login, POST /api/roles to create role, then PUT /api/roles/<id> with {permissions: {...}} -> 500. Fix: change to a dict (e.g. {k: True for k in updates.keys()}) or make _diff tolerant: if not isinstance(after, dict): after = {} (and similar for before).
